WITH multi_stint AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round, drive_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
    FROM drives
),
consecutive AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.stint_num, a.first_round as prev_first, a.last_round as prev_last, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor,
           b.first_round as next_first, b.last_round as next_last, b.constructor_id as next_constructor
    FROM multi_stint a
    JOIN multi_stint b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.stint_num = b.stint_num - 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, 
           prev_last + 1 as hiatus_first_round,
           next_first - 1 as hiatus_last_round,
           next_first - prev_last - 1 as races_missed
    FROM consecutive
)
SELECT * FROM with_gaps
WHERE races_missed > 0 AND races_missed < 3 AND prev_constructor != next_constructor
ORDER BY year, driver_id
